STATE OF NEW YORK

                                          9108

                    IN SENATE

                                    February 3, 2026
                                       ___________

        Introduced  by  Sen.  ORTT  --  read twice and ordered printed, and when
          printed to be committed to the Committee on Local Government

        AN ACT in relation to authorizing the town of Niagara  to  alienate  and
          discontinue  the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands
          to David Gaines

          {+The People of the State of New York, represented in Senate and  Assem-+}
        {+bly, do enact as follows:+}

     1    Section 1. Subject to the provisions of this act, the town of Niagara,
     2  county  of  Niagara,  is  hereby  authorized,  acting by and through its
     3  governing body, and upon such terms and conditions as determined by such
     4  governing body, to discontinue the use  as  parkland  and  alienate  the
     5  lands  described  in  section  three of this act, and to sell and convey
     6  property interests in such lands at fair market value to David Gaines.
     7    § 2. The authorization contained in section one of this act shall only
     8  be effective on the condition that  the  town  of  Niagara  dedicate  an
     9  amount  equal  to or greater than the fair market value of the parklands
    10  being alienated pursuant to section one of this act towards the acquisi-
    11  tion of new parklands and/or capital improvements to existing  park  and
    12  recreational facilities.
    13    § 3. The parklands authorized by section one of this act to be discon-
    14  tinued as parklands are described as follows:
    15    ALL THAT TRACT OR PARCEL OF LAND situate in the Town of Niagara, Coun-
    16  ty  of Niagara and State of New York, and being part of Lot No. 8, Town-
    17  ship 13, Range 9 of the Holland Land Purchase so  called,  more  partic-
    18  ularly described as follows:
    19    BEGINNING  at  a point which is located 242 feet east of the west line
    20  of Lot No. 8 and 927.7 feet south of the north line of Lot No. 8; thence
    21  running east along a line parallel to the north line of Lot No.   8  505
    22  feet; thence north along a line parallel to the west line of Lot No.  8,
    23  346.9  feet;  thence west along a line parallel to the north line of Lot
    24  No. 8 505 feet; thence south along a line parallel to the west  line  of
    25  Lot No. 8 to the point of beginning;
    26    ALL THAT TRACT OR PARCEL OF LAND situate in the Town of Niagara, Coun-
    27  ty  of  Niagara, and State of New York, being a part of Lot No. 8, Town-

     1  ship 13, Range 5 of the Holland Land Purchase so  called,  more  partic-
     2  ularly described as follows:
     3    BEGINNING  at  a  point 66 feet east of the west line of Lot No. 8 and
     4  927.7 feet south of the north line of Lot No. 8; thence easterly along a
     5  line parallel to the north line of Lot No. 8,  681  feet;  thence  south
     6  along  a  line  parallel  to the west line of Lot No. 8, 66 feet; thence
     7  west along a line parallel to the north line of Lot  No.  8,  681  feet;
     8  thence north 66 feet to the point of beginning; and
     9    ALL THAT TRACT OR PARCEL OF LAND situate in the Town of Niagara, Coun-
    10  ty  of Niagara and State of New York, and being part of Lot No. 8, Town-
    11  ship 13, Range 5 of the Holland Land Purchase so  called,  more  partic-
    12  ularly described as follows:
    13    BEGINNING  at  a point which is located 242 feet east of the west line
    14  of Lot No. 8 and 927.7 feet south of the north line of Lot No. 8; thence
    15  running east along a line parallel to the north of Lot No. 8, 505  feet;
    16  thence  north along a line parallel to the west line of Lot No. 8, 346.9
    17  feet; thence west along a line parallel to the north line of Lot No.  8,
    18  505 feet; thence south along a line parallel to the west line of Lot No.
    19  8 to the point of beginning.
    20    §  4.  In  the  event  that  the  town of Niagara received any funding
    21  support or assistance from the  federal  government  for  the  purchase,
    22  maintenance,  or improvement of the parklands set forth in section three
    23  of this act, the discontinuance and alienation of such parklands author-
    24  ized by the provisions of this act shall not occur  until  the  town  of
    25  Niagara  has  complied  with  any federal requirements pertaining to the
    26  alienation or conversion of parklands, including satisfying  the  secre-
    27  tary of the interior that the alienation or conversion complies with all
    28  conditions which the secretary of the interior deems necessary to assure
    29  the substitution of other lands shall be equivalent in fair market value
    30  and usefulness to the lands being alienated or converted.
    31    § 5. This act shall take effect immediately.
